Short instructions for GitHub Copilot and AI coding agents.

This repository includes a canonical agent guide at the repository root: see [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

If you are an automated code assistant, prefer the repository `AGENTS.md`. Follow these quick rules:

- Run `npm run test` and `npm run lint` locally before proposing changes.
- Keep edits small and well-scoped; link to affected files in your PR description.
- Refer to `tsconfig.json` for path alias resolution.

Maintainers: edit `AGENTS.md` for the authoritative guidance.
